description:
Schedule a recurring property search. Every run uses 1 search credit, or 2 when it makes more than 3 ZHomes calls (several event types, tax/sale-history events, furnished-only or description-based filters). New matches can be saved to a list and enriched automatically (auto_enrich spends skip-trace credits on every run, so confirm with the user).

Examples:
  - "every Monday 8am Central, Dallas rentals under $2k" -> frequency="weekly", day_of_week=1, run_time="08:00", timezone="America/Chicago", location="Dallas, TX", max_amount=2000
  - "last Friday of each month" -> frequency="monthly", day_of_week=5, week_of_month=-1
  - "every morning, new pre-foreclosures and price drops in Houston, save to my Distress list" -> frequency="daily", run_time="07:00", location="Houston, TX", events=["preforeclosure","price_drop"], list_id=…

Accepts the same advanced and event filters as spur_search_properties (min_amount / max_amount instead of min_price / max_price). Run the search once with spur_search_properties first so the user can check the results before scheduling.

In automations each event fires once, on the run that first sees it, so the same property isn't saved twice; change events start reporting from the second run. "delisted" is only available here.

Events (pass in `events`; a listing matches when ANY selected event fired, and is tagged with each):
- Listing lifecycle: new_listing, coming_soon, coming_soon_active, price_drop, price_increase, pending, sold, back_on_market, delisted (automations only), open_house, rental_listed, rent_change, move_in_moved_up
- Distress & motivation: preforeclosure, foreclosure, auction, bank_owned, distress_escalated, fsbo, agent_to_fsbo, stale_listing, new_construction
- Valuation & tax: tax_assessment_posted, assessed_value_jump, tax_paid_dropped (weak), sale_recorded, zestimate_moved, equity_gap, price_below_assessed
Direct events (price_drop, pending, sold, preforeclosure, fsbo, new_listing, …) work on the first search. Change events (price_increase, back_on_market, distress_escalated, agent_to_fsbo, rent_change, zestimate_moved, …) compare against what Spur saw on an earlier search of the same area, so the first search only records a baseline.
Motivated-seller research usually combines price_drop, back_on_market, stale_listing, agent_to_fsbo and the distress stages.

ai_query.description: Qualitative intent; each run re-ranks listings by description against it

auto_enrich.description: Skip-trace new matches on every run (spends enrichment credits)

auto_save.description: Save new matches to the user's properties

center_lat.description: Radius search centre (with center_lng and radius_miles)

center_lng.description: Radius search centre longitude (with center_lat and radius_miles)

days_posted.description: Only listings posted within this many days

event_min_change_pct.description: Minimum % move for price / rent / Zestimate / assessment events

event_min_equity_gap_pct.description: Minimum % Zestimate above last sale price for equity_gap (default 30)

event_stale_days.description: Days on market that counts as stale (default 90)

event_within_days.description: Lookback window for events, in days (default 7)

events.description: Only listings where any of these events happened; see the tool description

has_garage.description: true = only listings with a garage

has_pool.description: true = only listings with a pool

has_view.description: true = only listings with any view (use views on live search for a specific kind)

is_price_reduced.description: true = only listings whose asking price has been cut

list_id.description: Save new matches into this property list

listing_type.description: Seller / listing kind; for catching NEW entries into a distress stage prefer events

max_age.description: At most this many years since built

max_amount.description: Maximum price in USD (rent per month for forRent)

max_days_on_market.description: Listed at most this many days

max_ownership_years.description: Owner has held the property at most this long

max_sqft.description: Maximum living area in square feet

max_year_built.description: Built in or before this year

max_zip.description: Highest ZIP code in a numeric ZIP range (with min_zip)

min_amount.description: Minimum price in USD (rent per month for forRent)

min_days_on_market.description: Listed at least this many days (higher suggests a motivated seller)

min_equity.description: Estimated equity in USD (Zestimate or price minus assessed value; rough)

min_ownership_years.description: Owner has held the property at least this long

min_sqft.description: Minimum living area in square feet

min_year_built.description: Built in or after this year

min_zip.description: Lowest ZIP code in a numeric ZIP range (with max_zip); prefer zip_list for specific ZIPs

neighborhoods.description: Neighborhood / area names matched against address and description

only_vacant.description: Likely vacant (heuristic: description keywords + long days on market)

radius_miles.description: Keep only listings within this many miles of center_lat / center_lng

zip_list.description: Keep only these ZIPs; set location to the city that contains them
